lore_summary: A creature of the Blighted Expanse, aligned with Death energy. Known among tamers as a Risen Dead-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Blighted Expanse. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Blighted tamers are called Grave Keepers. They mark their bond through ceremonial death-and-rebirth oaths.

base_chain.name: Young Jade Undead Giant
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Jade Undead Giant. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Blighted Expanse. Jade Undead Giants in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Kindling Jade Undead Giant
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Death — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Blighted Expanse. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Jade Undead Giant
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Jade Undead Giant bears the aesthetic of Blighted Expanse — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Death crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Blighted Expanse. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

evolution_req.special: Clear  rest is sacred. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Crowned Jade Undead Giant
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Blighted Expanse-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Blighted Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Blighted Expanse, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Jade Undead Giant — Blighted Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Blighted path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Blighted Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Jade Undead Giant is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Blighted Expanse. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

star_6.name: Jade Undead Giant of the Apex
star_6.appearance: Jade Undead Giant now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Jade Undead Giants have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Ancient Death Stone

star_7.name: Absolute Jade Undead Giant
star_7.appearance: The final form. Jade Undead Giant stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Jade Undead Giant is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Last Rite" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Blighted Expanse. Charred Corpse IVs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Emerging Charred Corpse IV
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Death — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Blighted Expanse. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Blighted Expanse. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Fetid Bone Knight Awakened
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Bone Knight Awakened bears the aesthetic of Blighted Expanse — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Death crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Blighted Expanse. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

evolution_req.special: Clear  rest is sacred. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Chosen Bone Knight Awakened
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Blighted Expanse-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Blighted Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Blighted Expanse, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Bone Knight Awakened — Blighted Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Blighted path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Blighted Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Bone Knight Awakened is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Blighted Expanse. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

star_6.name: Bone Knight Awakened of the Abyss
star_6.appearance: Bone Knight Awakened now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Bone Knight Awakeneds have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Ancient Death Stone

star_7.name: God-King Bone Knight Awakened
star_7.appearance: The final form. Bone Knight Awakened stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Bone Knight Awakened is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Last Rite" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Young Ether Undead Dragon

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.

base_chain.name: Fledgling Walker Tamed
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Walker Tamed. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Blighted Expanse. Walker Tameds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Stirring Walker Tamed

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.

lore_summary: A creature of the Blighted Expanse, aligned with Death energy. Known among tamers as a Knight-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Blighted Expanse. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Blighted tamers are called Grave Keepers. They mark their bond through ceremonial death-and-rebirth oaths.

base_chain.name: Pup Ravaged Rot Knight
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Ravaged Rot Knight. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Blighted Expanse. Ravaged Rot Knights in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Awakened Ravaged Rot Knight
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Death — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Blighted Expanse. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

tamer_note: Blighted tamers are called Grave Keepers. They mark their bond through ceremonial death-and-rebirth oaths.

base_chain.name: Bud Wild Gloaming Walker Senior
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Wild Gloaming Walker Senior. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Blighted Expanse. Wild Gloaming Walker Seniors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Awakened Wild Gloaming Walker Senior
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Death — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Blighted Expanse. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Wild Gloaming Walker Senior
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Wild Gloaming Walker Senior bears the aesthetic of Blighted Expanse — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Death crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Blighted Expanse. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

evolution_req.special: Clear  rest is sacred. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Ascendant Wild Gloaming Walker Senior
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Blighted Expanse-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Blighted Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Blighted Expanse, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Wild Gloaming Walker Senior — Blighted Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Blighted path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Blighted Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Wild Gloaming Walker Senior is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Blighted Expanse. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

star_6.name: Wild Gloaming Walker Senior the First
star_6.appearance: Wild Gloaming Walker Senior now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Wild Gloaming Walker Seniors have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Ancient Death Stone

star_7.name: Sublime Wild Gloaming Walker Senior
star_7.appearance: The final form. Wild Gloaming Walker Senior stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Wild Gloaming Walker Senior is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Last Rite" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

tamer_note: Blighted tamers are called Grave Keepers. They mark their bond through ceremonial death-and-rebirth oaths.

base_chain.name: Fledgling Sorrow Cinder Knight Minor
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Sorrow Cinder Knight Minor. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Blighted Expanse. Sorrow Cinder Knight Minors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Rising Sorrow Cinder Knight Minor
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Death — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Blighted Expanse. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Blighted Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Blighted Expanse, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Siege Ashen Colossus — Blighted Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Blighted path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Blighted Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Siege Ashen Colossus is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Blighted Expanse. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

star_6.name: Siege Ashen Colossus the Revered
star_6.appearance: Siege Ashen Colossus now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Siege Ashen Colossuss have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Ancient Death Stone

star_7.name: Apex Siege Ashen Colossus
star_7.appearance: The final form. Siege Ashen Colossus stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Siege Ashen Colossus is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Last Rite" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Blighted Expanse. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Blighted tamers are called Grave Keepers. They mark their bond through ceremonial death-and-rebirth oaths.

base_chain.name: Spawn Blazing Bone Dragon
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Blazing Bone Dragon. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Blighted Expanse. Blazing Bone Dragons in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Awakened Blazing Bone Dragon
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Death — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Blighted Expanse. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Hatchling Champion Supreme Hollow

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Blighted Expanse. Champion Supreme Hollows in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Stirring Champion Supreme Hollow
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Death — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Blighted Expanse. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Young Cursed Undead Dragon

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Blighted Expanse. Cursed Undead Dragons in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.

base_chain.name: Kindling Cursed Undead Dragon

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.

It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Blighted Expanse. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Blighted tamers are called Grave Keepers. They mark their bond through ceremonial death-and-rebirth oaths.

base_chain.name: Fledgling Ash Hollow Cursed
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Ash Hollow Cursed. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Blighted Expanse. Ash Hollow Curseds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: First-Form Ash Hollow Cursed
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Death — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Blighted Expanse. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.

base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Fledgling Hollow I
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Hollow I. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Blighted Expanse. Hollow Is in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Stirring Hollow I
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Death — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Blighted Expanse. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Blighted Expanse. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

evolution_req.special: Clear  rest is sacred. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Chosen Wrath Corrupted Dragon
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Blighted Expanse-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Blighted Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Blighted Expanse, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Wrath Corrupted Dragon — Blighted Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Blighted path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Blighted Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Wrath Corrupted Dragon is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Blighted Expanse. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

star_6.name: Wrath Corrupted Dragon the Last
star_6.appearance: Wrath Corrupted Dragon now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Wrath Corrupted Dragons have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Ancient Death Stone

base_chain.name: Bud Siege Mistborn Shade
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Siege Mistborn Shade. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Blighted Expanse. Siege Mistborn Shades in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Awakened Siege Mistborn Shade
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Death — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Blighted Expanse. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Blighted Expanse. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

evolution_req.special: Clear  rest is sacred. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Chosen Cursed Corrupted Giant
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Blighted Expanse-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Blighted Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Blighted Expanse, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Cursed Corrupted Giant — Blighted Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Blighted path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Blighted Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Cursed Corrupted Giant is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Blighted Expanse. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

star_6.name: Cursed Corrupted Giant of the Abyss
star_6.appearance: Cursed Corrupted Giant now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Cursed Corrupted Giants have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Ancient Death Stone

star_7.name: Final Cursed Corrupted Giant
star_7.appearance: The final form. Cursed Corrupted Giant stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Cursed Corrupted Giant is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Last Rite" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Fledgling Rotten Crypt Walker VI
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Rotten Crypt Walker VI. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.

base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Blighted Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Blighted Expanse, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Murky Dusk Walker Minor — Blighted Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Blighted path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Blighted Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Murky Dusk Walker Minor is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Blighted Expanse. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

star_6.name: Murky Dusk Walker Minor of the Apex
star_6.appearance: Murky Dusk Walker Minor now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Murky Dusk Walker Minors have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Ancient Death Stone

star_7.name: Absolute Murky Dusk Walker Minor
star_7.appearance: The final form. Murky Dusk Walker Minor stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.

base_chain.name: Newborn Gaunt Barrow Walker Minor
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Gaunt Barrow Walker Minor. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Blighted Expanse. Gaunt Barrow Walker Minors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: First-Form Gaunt Barrow Walker Minor
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Death — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Blighted Expanse. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Lesser Pitted Decay Knight

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Blighted Expanse. Pitted Decay Knights in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.

base_chain.name: Rising Pitted Decay Knight

It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Blighted Expanse. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Blighted tamers are called Grave Keepers. They mark their bond through ceremonial death-and-rebirth oaths.

base_chain.name: Bud Shadow Walker Alpha
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Shadow Walker Alpha. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Blighted Expanse. Shadow Walker Alphas in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Awakened Shadow Walker Alpha
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Death — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Blighted Expanse. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Fledgling Dusk Walker
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Dusk Walker. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Blighted Expanse. Dusk Walkers in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Rising Dusk Walker
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Death — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Blighted Expanse. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Wisp Burned Hollow
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Burned Hollow. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Blighted Expanse. Burned Hollows in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: First-Form Burned Hollow
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Death — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Blighted Expanse. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Blighted Expanse. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Blighted tamers are called Grave Keepers. They mark their bond through ceremonial death-and-rebirth oaths.

base_chain.name: Bud Abyssal Knight Commander
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Abyssal Knight Commander. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Blighted Expanse. Abyssal Knight Commanders in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Emerging Abyssal Knight Commander
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Death — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Blighted Expanse. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Blighted Expanse. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Death Corrupted Knight
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Death Corrupted Knight bears the aesthetic of Blighted Expanse — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Death crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Blighted Expanse. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

evolution_req.special: Clear  rest is sacred. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Marked Death Corrupted Knight
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Blighted Expanse-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Blighted Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Blighted Expanse, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Death Corrupted Knight — Blighted Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Blighted path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Blighted Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Death Corrupted Knight is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Blighted Expanse. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

star_6.name: Death Corrupted Knight the Revered
star_6.appearance: Death Corrupted Knight now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Death Corrupted Knights have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Ancient Death Stone

base_chain.name: Crowned Undead Champion Feral
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Blighted Expanse-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Blighted Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Blighted Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.

star_6.name: Undead Champion Feral the First

star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.

base_chain.name: Young Supreme Gwyn Fragment
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Supreme Gwyn Fragment. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Blighted Expanse. Supreme Gwyn Fragments in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.

star_6.name: Voidborn Abyssal Knight Incarnate

star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.

lore_summary: A creature of the Blighted Expanse, aligned with Death energy. Known among tamers as a Ossein-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Blighted Expanse. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Blighted tamers are called Grave Keepers. They mark their bond through ceremonial death-and-rebirth oaths.

base_chain.name: Newborn Infernal Skeleton Giant
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Infernal Skeleton Giant. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Blighted Expanse. Infernal Skeleton Giants in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: First-Form Infernal Skeleton Giant
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Death — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Blighted Expanse. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Blighted Expanse. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Newborn Yellow Lost Soul Cursed
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Yellow Lost Soul Cursed. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Blighted Expanse. Yellow Lost Soul Curseds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Rising Yellow Lost Soul Cursed
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Death — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Blighted Expanse. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

lore_summary: A creature of the Blighted Expanse, aligned with Death energy. Known among tamers as a Knight-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Blighted Expanse. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Blighted tamers are called Grave Keepers. They mark their bond through ceremonial death-and-rebirth oaths.

base_chain.name: Spawn Herald Elder Grave Warden
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Herald Elder Grave Warden. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Blighted Expanse. Herald Elder Grave Wardens in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Kindling Herald Elder Grave Warden
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Death — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Blighted Expanse. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

lore_summary: A creature of the Blighted Expanse, aligned with Death energy. Known among tamers as a Risen Dead-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Blighted Expanse. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Blighted tamers are called Grave Keepers. They mark their bond through ceremonial death-and-rebirth oaths.

base_chain.name: Hatchling Gaunt Undead Pilgrim Minor
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Gaunt Undead Pilgrim Minor. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Blighted Expanse. Gaunt Undead Pilgrim Minors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Rising Gaunt Undead Pilgrim Minor
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Death — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Blighted Expanse. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Spawn Runed Elite Death Knight

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.

lore_summary: A creature of the Blighted Expanse, aligned with Death energy. Known among tamers as a Void Entity-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Blighted Expanse. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Blighted tamers are called Grave Keepers. They mark their bond through ceremonial death-and-rebirth oaths.

base_chain.name: Spawn Undying Abyssal Hollow
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Undying Abyssal Hollow. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Blighted Expanse. Undying Abyssal Hollows in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Awakened Undying Abyssal Hollow
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Death — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Blighted Expanse. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.

lore_summary: A creature of the Blighted Expanse, aligned with Death energy. Known among tamers as a Knight-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Blighted Expanse. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Blighted tamers are called Grave Keepers. They mark their bond through ceremonial death-and-rebirth oaths.

base_chain.name: Young Mire Tomb Knight Senior
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Mire Tomb Knight Senior. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Blighted Expanse. Mire Tomb Knight Seniors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Awakened Mire Tomb Knight Senior
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Death — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Blighted Expanse. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Bud Chaos Undead Dragon
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Chaos Undead Dragon. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Blighted Expanse. Chaos Undead Dragons in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Kindling Chaos Undead Dragon
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Death — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.

base_chain.name: Bud Rotten Dusk Walker I

base_chain.name: Bud Dark Walker Ancient

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Blighted Expanse. Dark Walker Ancients in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.

base_chain.name: Bud Lord Crowned Hollow
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Lord Crowned Hollow. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Blighted Expanse. Lord Crowned Hollows in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Awakened Lord Crowned Hollow
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Death — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Blighted Expanse. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

tamer_note: Blighted tamers are called Grave Keepers. They mark their bond through ceremonial death-and-rebirth oaths.

base_chain.name: Pup Burned Hollow
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Burned Hollow. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Blighted Expanse. Burned Hollows in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Emerging Burned Hollow
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Death — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Blighted Expanse. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Bleak Burned Hollow
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Burned Hollow bears the aesthetic of Blighted Expanse — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Death crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Blighted Expanse. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

evolution_req.special: Clear  rest is sacred. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Crowned Burned Hollow
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Blighted Expanse-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Blighted Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Blighted Expanse, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Burned Hollow — Blighted Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Blighted path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Blighted Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Burned Hollow is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Blighted Expanse. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

star_6.name: Burned Hollow the First
star_6.appearance: Burned Hollow now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Burned Hollows have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Ancient Death Stone

star_7.name: Absolute Burned Hollow
star_7.appearance: The final form. Burned Hollow stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Burned Hollow is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Last Rite" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Pup Lanky Burned Hollow Beta
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Lanky Burned Hollow Beta. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Blighted Expanse. Lanky Burned Hollow Betas in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Emerging Lanky Burned Hollow Beta
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Death — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Blighted Expanse. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Fledgling Crude Cursed Pilgrim VII
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Crude Cursed Pilgrim VII. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Blighted Expanse. Crude Cursed Pilgrim VIIs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Rising Crude Cursed Pilgrim VII
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Death — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Blighted Expanse. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Young Cursed Knight Prime
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Cursed Knight Prime. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Blighted Expanse. Cursed Knight Primes in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Emerging Cursed Knight Prime
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Death — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Blighted Expanse. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Young Feral Ash Zombie
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Feral Ash Zombie. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Blighted Expanse. Feral Ash Zombies in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Kindling Feral Ash Zombie
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Death — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Blighted Expanse. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage
